Same AI model, same prompt. One reply is generic AI slop. The other one sounds like me, with my real numbers, because it is connected to my brain.

In this video I show you how to build that brain: a private GitHub repo of markdown files that holds who you are, how you write, and what you believe. It runs two ways. Locally with Claude Code, and online on your own server with MCP and API access, so any AI agent you use can read it. Free, open source, self hosted.
